cloudflare_zero_trust_policies.name: AI Supply Chain & Open-Weights Egress Security
cloudflare_zero_trust_policies.description: Enforces destination-side egress filtering on developer rigs and staging clusters to prevent exfiltration and unapproved open-weight downloads.

rules.name: Block Unapproved Foreign Model Hubs
rules.description: Prevents unauthorized download of unaligned open-weight checkpoints (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen) onto corporate workstations.
rules.block_page_reason: Policy Violation: Unaudited foreign open-weight models must undergo mechanistic security auditing before download.

rules.name: Enforce Cloudflare AI Gateway Reverse Proxy
rules.description: Forces all internal LLM API traffic through the Cloudflare AI Gateway for rate-limiting, prompt caching, and anti-distillation watermarking.
rules.block_page_reason: Policy Violation: Direct outbound LLM traffic blocked. Use enterprise Cloudflare AI Gateway proxy.

rules.name: Isolate High-Velocity Model Scraping (Anti-Distillation)
rules.description: Limits repetitive prompt queries exceeding 100 requests/minute per developer subnet to prevent automated model distillation.
